map.上传 PDF 文件，按页码范围或可视化勾选提取指定页面，生成新的 PDF。所有处: Upload a PDF and extract the pages you want by page range or by visually selecting thumbnails, generating a new PDF. All processing happens locally in the browser and files are never uploaded to a server.
map.从一份大合同中提取签字页或特定章节，单独拆分出来发送。: Extract the signature page or a specific section from a large contract and send it separately.
map.按「1-3, 5, 7-10」这样的页码范围快速截取若干不连续页。: Quickly extract several non-consecutive pages using a range like "1-3, 5, 7-10".
map.用可视化缩略图勾选方式，所见即所得地挑选要保留的页面。: Select pages visually with what-you-see-is-what-you-get thumbnails.
map.：在页码范围输入框填写「1-3, 5, 7-10」，工具会按该顺序提取对应页生成: Enter "1-3, 5, 7-10" in the page range box and the tool extracts those pages in that order into a new PDF; you can also select directly from thumbnails, with one-click select all / invert / odd-even shortcuts. All processing happens locally in the browser and files are not uploaded to a server.
map.如何按不连续页码拆分？: How do I split at non-consecutive page numbers?
map.在页码范围输入框用「1-3, 5, 7-10」格式描述：短横线表示连续区间、逗号: In the page range box, describe ranges like "1-3, 5, 7-10": a dash means a continuous range and commas separate segments, and extraction follows the order you type.
map.加密/密码保护的 PDF 可以读取页数与缩略图，但提取页面时可能受限；建议先去除: Encrypted or password-protected PDFs can be read for page count and thumbnails, but page extraction may be restricted; remove the protection first. Generating thumbnails for files over 50 pages may take a few seconds.
